apps.name: Surge
apps.subtitle: Power strip control and Shortcuts
apps.localizedDescription: Control your Joly Joy-compatible smart power strip through the existing Keystone ESP32 bridge, with Apple Shortcuts and Apple Home integration. Compatible Tuya LAN strip and current Keystone firmware required.

- First Socket iPhone release: per-outlet power controls and status over Keystone's bridge.
